children: At least 12 people died and one person is still missing after torrential rain triggered a mudslide that hit a town in southern Chinese province of Jiangxi, state news agency Xinhua reported Tuesday, raising an earlier estimate of the toll.
The mudslide struck the town of Gaoping around 4 a.m. on Saturday (2000 GMT Friday) after downpours linked to Typhoon Saudel saturated mountain soil in the surrounding area.
Rescuers were still trying to find the missing person, Xinhua reported.
Typhoon Saudel made three landfalls in eastern China, with its third along the coast of Fujian province, a neighbour of Jiangxi, on September 3.
